title.narrative: Workshop kring tillståndsgivning för medicinsk röntgen utrustning
Workshop on licensing for medical radiation equipment

description.narrative: Förbättrad kunskap hos den regulatoriska myndigheten SNRIU om hur EU:s regelverk avseende medicinsk röntgenutrustning kan implementeras i nationellt regelverk
Improved competence within the Ukrainian regulatory authority SNRIU on how the EU regulation regarding medical radiation equipment can be implemented within the national regulatory framework
Stödja State Nuclear Regulatory Inspectorate of Ukraine (SNRIU) avseende utveckla regelverk och tillståndsgivning avseende medicinsk röntgenutrustning
Support the State Nuclear Regulatory Inspectorate of Ukraine (SNRIU) regarding developing regulations and licencing of medical radiation equipment

Increased knowledge for six experts from Ukraine, through exchange of experience with the Swedish agency SSM and the Swedish health service, regarding how the EU regulation for the medical radiation equipment can be implemented within the national regulatory framework

Ökad kunskap hos 6 experter från Ukraina, genom erfarenhetsutbyte med den svenska myndigheten SSM och svensk sjukvård, om hur EU:s regelverk avseende medicinsk röntgenutrustning kan implementeras i nationellt regelverk
